response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled and experienced individual contributor with strong software craftsmanship and distributed systems expertise. However, he lacks the executive leadership experience required for this CTO role, specifically the track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, developing senior management layers, and operating multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes fintech environments.
strengths: Extensive backend and distributed systems experience, including high-volume microservices and event-driven architectures.
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing methodologies (TDD), and robust CI/CD pipelines.
concerns: Lacks the required 5+ years of senior technical leadership experience scaling engineering organizations.
No evidence of deploying multi-agent AI systems in regulated, high-stakes commercial or fintech environments.
Missing executive experience in board communication, structuring governance frameworks, and managing external delivery partners.
